hooks.name: Flatpak Manifest Validator
hooks.description: When Cargo.lock changes, notes that packaging/*/cargo-sources.json are older than the lockfile, so the Flatpak build would vendor the previous dependency set. Was an agent action — a full agent loop per Cargo.lock save to run `test -f` twice and print a fixed warning. Now a timestamp comparison in a script, delivered through target/.kiro-session-report and printed by the Session Report (deliver) hook on the next turn. Never regenerates: cargo-sources.json is a large generated artefact and regenerating it is a deliberate pre-release act. Fails open. Logic: bin/flatpak-manifest-check.sh.
